parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include alert contact groups in the response. Valid values:
true: Include alert contact groups.
false: Do not include alert contact groups
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中是否需要包含报警联系组。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: select_contact_groups

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

起始值：1。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The resource instance ID. This parameter is used to query the application group to which the specified instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源实例ID。该参数用于查询指定实例所在的应用分组
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the history of alert templates that have been applied to the application group. Valid values:
true: Include the history.
false: Do not include the history
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果是否包含已应用到应用分组的报警模板历史。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: include_template_history

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application group. Valid values:
custom: a user-created application group.
ehpc_cluster: an application group through synchronization from an E-HPC cluster.
kubernetes: an application group through synchronization from Container Service for Kubernetes.
tag: an application group through automatic creation by using labels.
resMgr: an application group created from a resource group.
ess: an application group through synchronization from elastic scaling (ESS)
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组类型。取值：
custom：自建的应用分组。
ehpc_cluster：从EHPC集群同步的应用分组。
kubernetes：从容器服务Kubernetes版同步的应用分组。
tag：通过标签自动创建的应用分组。
resMgr：通过资源组创建的应用分组。
ess：从弹性伸缩ESS同步的应用分组。
aone_group：从 Aone 应用同步/关联过来的应用分组
parameters.name: type

parameters.name: dynamic_tag_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The tag value used to create the application group by using dynamic rule matching
parameters.help_zh: 通过智能标签创建应用分组的标签值

parameters.help_en: The application group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID。多个应用分组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
